limits.title: Honest about its limits.
limits.lead: Lighting, dirt and reflections can mislead any comparison.

confidence.title: It states its confidence
confidence.body: Each finding says how sure the comparison is, in words a renter can read.

retake.title: It asks for a retake
retake.body: A blurred or dark photograph is caught on the phone, while it is still easy to take again.

defers.title: It defers to a person
defers.body: When it cannot tell wear from damage, it says so and a person looks. The manual path always works.

pipeline.title: Seven steps. The model gets one.
pipeline.lead: The cheapest reliable method goes first. Anything that must not be missed is found by plain code, and still works when the model is down.

quality.title: Check the photograph
quality.body: On the phone, as it is taken. A blurred, dark or badly framed shot is rejected at once.

normalize.title: Even it out
normalize.body: Orientation, size and exposure are corrected.

align.title: Line it up
align.body: The return photograph is aligned with its twin from the handover.

regions.title: Find what changed
regions.body: Areas that differ are marked as hints for the next step.

judge.title: Judge
judge.body: The model looks at both photographs and a close crop of each area. It answers no change, wear or damage, and says how sure it is.

price.title: Price
price.body: Each finding is matched to the shop's published list. An amount is never the model's output.

decide.title: Decide

charge.a: No. A hold reserves the amount in the renter's own PayPal account. Nothing is taken unless a person approves a claim.

length.q: How long can a hold stay open?
length.a: Up to 29 days. Hold keeps it valid during the rental and flags any hold that is close to its end before it lapses.

beyond.q: What if the damage costs more than the hold?
beyond.a: The hold is taken in full and the balance is billed separately, with the same photographs attached.

app.q: Does anyone need an app or an account?
app.a: No. Staff open Hold in the browser on the phone they already carry. The renter gets a link.

dark.q: What if a photograph is too dark to judge?
dark.a: Hold asks for it again while the item is still at the counter. If it still cannot tell, it says so and a person looks at the item itself.

wear.q: Who decides what counts as ordinary wear?
wear.a: The shop does, once, in plain words. Hold applies that policy the same way to every renter.

release.a: The moment staff confirm a clean return, usually while you are still at the counter. Your phone tells you that nothing was charged.

chargedFor.q: What can I be charged for?
chargedFor.a: Only damage that is on the published price list, shown in the photographs and approved by a person. A claim can never be higher than the list.

disagree.q: What if I disagree with a claim?
disagree.a: You say so on the same screen and can add your own photographs. A named person at the shop looks at both sides and can lower or drop the charge.

photographs.a: They show the item, not you. Faces are blurred, and records are kept only as long as the shop's policy and the law require.
